metadata.name: Better Mods Menu
metadata.description:
[h1]Better Mods Menu[/h1] The vanilla Mods menu, redrawn with the game's own paper sprites and made actually usable with a big mod list. This mod is fully vibe-coded.
[b]Requires REPENTOGON.[/b]
[list] [*] The page stays still and the list scrolls smoothly under its header [*] Checkboxes, category stamps (API / CONTENT / QOL / VISUAL) and a pending-change marker on every mod [*] Info card: name, version, Workshop id, tags, preview picture and the description [*] Dependency warnings when an enabled mod needs one that is off; press D to enable what is missing [*] Filters (Q/E or LB/RB): all, on, off, pinned, API, content, QoL, visual, changed, broken [*] Sorting (S): by name, enabled first, by category [*] Pinned mods (B) always stay on top [*] Profiles (P): save up to 4 mod sets, plus "as at game start" and "everything off" [*] REPENTOGON search (CTRL) and undo (BACKSPACE) keep working [*] F2 switches back to the plain vanilla list [*] English and Russian (follows the game language, L to switch) [/list]
Mods are still switched by the game itself, so nothing about saving changes. Applying a profile walks the cursor through every mod that has to change; press ENTER once per mod.
Previews: a mod's own thumb.png (PNG) is shown automatically. For the rest, run tools/make_thumbs.py --download (Python 3 + Pillow) to fetch the Workshop pictures.
